# Release v2.102.0

Generating release notes from v2.101.4 to HEAD
### 🔧 Maintenance

- Update n8n to 2.46.7 and bump version to 2.102.0 (f9c69ed)

---

**Release Statistics:**
- 1 commit
- 1 contributor
- Contributors: czlonkowski

---

## Installation

### NPM Package
```bash
# Install globally
npm install -g n8n-mcp

# Or run directly
npx n8n-mcp
```

### Docker
```bash
# Standard image
docker run -p 3000:3000 ghcr.io/czlonkowski/n8n-mcp:v2.102.0

# Railway optimized
docker run -p 3000:3000 ghcr.io/czlonkowski/n8n-mcp-railway:v2.102.0
```
